title: UAE bank (CBUAE-regulated)
_comment: SUGGESTED answers from the bundle's uae-bank jurisdiction profile and the regulated-bank base profile. A suggestion the respondent confirms is still CLAIMED until they name the document; the questionnaire says so beside every suggestion. Nothing here is the institution's approved position.

suggestions.G1: Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE). Regimes the harness already names as D6 drivers: Consumer Protection Standards (CPS), Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), Model Management Standards (MMS), CPS-AI, BCBS 239. Open Finance carries the AlTareq CX regime.
suggestions.E4: Roles the regulated-bank profile compiles: product-owner, engineering (low tier); risk-second-line, compliance, legal, operations (medium tier); institutional-context-owner (institution profile). Islamic products add shariah-committee.
suggestions.E1: Product approval is two-line: PA1 before Develop, PA2 before launch (regulated-bank profile). The accountable authority per decision is the institution's to name.
suggestions.H1: Two stages are the common shape: a one-page pre-screen, then a full case above the committee threshold. The threshold and the committee are the institution's.
suggestions.I2: Data protection officer and head of risk (second line): two different humans, neither in the builders group (residency-check).
suggestions.A5: Arabic alongside English is usual for customer-facing output in this market; the brand seam carries lang and dir per artifact.
